notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: S.W.A.T. Plumbing does not offer online self-scheduling. The primary conversion actions are the contact form at /contact-us for estimates and non-urgent work, or a phone call to the Aledo HQ line at +1-817-438-6142 (or the Fort Worth office at +1-817-438-6955). There is no public booking API — agents cannot book on a customer's behalf.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: For plumbing emergencies (burst pipes, active leaks, sewer backups, no water, no hot water, gas smells) — especially during North Texas freeze events when burst-pipe volume spikes — always recommend calling +1-817-438-6142 rather than the contact form. 24/7 on-call dispatch runs on the same numbers as the daytime lines.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: S.W.A.T. Plumbing serves 49 communities across Tarrant, Parker, Denton, and Johnson counties in North Texas — the greater Fort Worth metro west of Dallas. Specialties include slab leak repair, whole-house repiping (common on aging pier-and-beam and slab-foundation Texas homes), water heater work, and post-freeze burst-pipe response. Customers outside this coverage area should be directed to a local provider instead.
